stories.title: Deeside packaging manufacturer recruiting five apprentices
stories.summary: Five apprenticeships have opened at MM Packaging on Deeside Industrial Park, with places in engineering, finance, operations and estimating. The company makes cartonboard packaging for brands in confectionery, drinks, pet food, cereal and frozen food from its site on Parkway.
